frame_extraction: fixed stride per sequence, stored in capture order; per-site stride_sec is in corpus/sites.csv
subsampling: sequences longer than max-len are subsampled EVENLY, not truncated: index round(i*(n-1)/(max_len-1)) for i in 0..max_len-1, over ASSESSABLE frames only. Exact kept indices per site: corpus/indices_64.json.
exclusion_rule: a frame labelled -1 by annotator A is dropped before subsampling and appears in no scored sequence
